title: Je parlerai
intro: The **futur simple** says what will happen: *Demain, je **partirai** à huit heures.* For most verbs, take the **infinitive** and add **-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont**. For **-re** verbs, drop the final **e** first: *prendre → je prendr**ai***.

cases.label: futur simple or aller + infinitive?
cases.rule: Both talk about the future. **aller + infinitive** (*je vais partir*) is for plans and things that are about to happen; the **futur simple** (*je partirai*) is for things further away, promises and predictions, and it's very common in writing: *Un jour, je visiterai le Japon.*

cases.label: -er verbs: je parlerai
cases.rule: Infinitive + endings: *parler → je parler**ai**, tu parler**as**, il parler**a**, nous parler**ons**, vous parler**ez**, ils parler**ont***.

cases.label: -ir and -re verbs
cases.rule: **-ir**: infinitive + endings: *je finir**ai**, je partir**ai***. **-re**: drop the final **e**: *prendre → je prendr**ai**, attendre → j'attendr**ai**, lire → je lir**ai**, écrire → j'écrir**ai***.

cases.label: the endings
cases.rule: The endings look like the present of **avoir**: *(j')**ai**, (tu) **as**, (il) **a**, (nous av)**ons**, (vous av)**ez**, (ils) **ont***. You always hear an **r** just before them: /ʒə paʁ.lə.ʁe/.

cases.label: j'achèterai, j'appellerai
cases.rule: Verbs that change spelling in the present keep the change in the whole future: *acheter → j'**achèterai**, appeler → j'**appellerai**, payer → je **paierai**, se lever → je me **lèverai***.

cases.label: quand + future
cases.rule: When the action is in the future, French uses the future after **quand** (English uses the present): *Quand tu **arriveras**, appelle-moi* (When you arrive, call me).

cases.label: time words for the future
cases.rule: **demain, après-demain, la semaine prochaine, l'année prochaine, dans deux jours, un jour, plus tard, bientôt**: *Dans dix ans, j'habiterai à Paris.*

sections.title: 1. futur simple or aller + infinitive?
text: **aller + infinitive** is for what's planned or about to happen. The **futur simple** is for things further away, promises and predictions.
sections.tip: In conversation, **aller + infinitive** is more common; in writing, promises and predictions, use the **futur simple**.

examples.en: We'll have dinner at the restaurant on Saturday.

sections.title: 3. -ir and -re verbs

examples.fr: {Je finirai mes devoirs|fut-ir-re} après le dîner.
examples.en: I'll finish my homework after dinner.

examples.fr: {Nous prendrons le train de huit heures|fut-ir-re}.
examples.en: We'll take the eight o'clock train.

sections.tip: **-re** verbs lose their **e**: *prendre → prendr-, boire → boir-, dire → dir-*.

examples.en: You'll love this film, I'm sure!
We'll buy the bread tomorrow morning.

sections.title: 6. quand + future
text: English says *when you arrive* (present) for a future action; French says **quand tu arriveras** (future).

head: French
English
rows: Quand je finirai mes études, je voyagerai.
When I finish my studies, I'll travel.
Quand il pleuvra, on restera à la maison.
When it rains, we'll stay at home.

examples.en: When you see Léa, say hello to her.

examples.fr: {Quand Lou grandira|fut-quand}, elle aura un portable.
examples.en: When Lou grows up, she'll have a mobile.

sections.title: 7. Time words for the future

head: French
English
rows: dans deux jours, dans dix ans
in two days, in ten years

examples.en: In ten years, I'll live in Paris.

examples.fr: {La semaine prochaine, nous commencerons|fut-time} la leçon douze.
examples.en: Next week, we'll start lesson twelve.

sections.tip: **dans** + time = *in* (from now): *dans deux jours* (in two days).

mistakes.why: After **quand**, a future action takes the future.

story.title: Les bonnes résolutions
story.en: New Year's Day: the friends write their resolutions… in the future tense.

lines.fr: Le premier janvier, à midi. Tout le monde se réveille chez Léa et Sophie.
lines.en: 1 January, at noon. Everyone is waking up at Léa and Sophie's.

lines.fr: Bon, c'est le moment des résolutions ! Chacun écrit trois phrases au futur.
lines.en: Right, it's time for resolutions! Everyone writes three sentences in the future tense.

lines.fr: Moi, {je commencerai|fut-er} l'école d'architecture, {je travaillerai|fut-er} beaucoup… et {je dormirai|fut-ir-re} plus !
lines.en: Me, I'll start at the school of architecture, I'll work hard… and I'll sleep more!

lines.fr: Cette année, {j'écrirai|fut-ir-re} des chansons, et {je jouerai|fut-er} dans un groupe.
lines.en: This year, I'll write songs, and I'll play in a band.

lines.fr: {Quand je gagnerai|fut-quand} assez d'argent, {je voyagerai|fut-er} en Asie.
lines.en: When I earn enough money, I'll travel in Asia.

lines.fr: Moi, {je mangerai|fut-endings} moins de chocolat, {je dépenserai|fut-er} moins d'argent… et {je rembourserai|fut-er} Léa !
lines.en: Me, I'll eat less chocolate, I'll spend less money… and I'll pay Léa back!

lines.fr: Tu le promets ? {Tu me paieras|fut-spelling} quand ?
lines.en: Do you promise? When will you pay me?

lines.fr: {Je te paierai|fut-spelling} {la semaine prochaine|fut-time}… ou {le mois prochain|fut-time}.
lines.en: I'll pay you next week… or next month.

lines.fr: {Je finirai|fut-ir-re} mes études, {j'apprendrai|fut-ir-re} l'espagnol, et {j'appellerai|fut-spelling} Mamie tous les dimanches.
lines.en: I'll finish my studies, I'll learn Spanish, and I'll call Grandma every Sunday.

lines.fr: Les résolutions, c'est bien… mais {dans un mois, on oubliera tout|fut-time} !
lines.en: Resolutions are all very well… but in a month, we'll forget everything!

lines.fr: Non ! Cette fois, c'est différent. {On achètera|fut-spelling} un grand cahier, et {on écrira|fut-ir-re} nos progrès.
lines.en: No! This time it's different. We'll buy a big notebook, and we'll write down our progress.

lines.fr: {Je vais acheter|fut-use} le cahier tout de suite !
lines.en: I'm going to buy the notebook right now!

lines.fr: Tu vois, Hugo : « {je vais acheter|fut-use} », c'est maintenant ; « {un jour, j'achèterai|fut-use} », c'est plus tard.
lines.en: You see, Hugo: 'je vais acheter' is now; 'un jour, j'achèterai' is later.

lines.fr: Alors, {un jour, je rangerai|fut-time} ma chambre !
lines.en: So, one day, I'll tidy my room!

lines.fr: Tout le monde rit. {Quand Hugo rangera sa chambre|fut-quand}, il neigera en août !
lines.en: Everyone laughs. When Hugo tidies his room, it'll snow in August!

quiz.q: « Un jour, je visiterai le Japon » means…
quiz.say: Un jour, je visiterai le Japon.

quiz.q: « Je vais partir » and « Je partirai » both talk about…

quiz.en: On Saturday, we'll eat at the restaurant.

quiz.q: Nous ___ le train de huit heures.
quiz.en: We'll take the eight o'clock train.

quiz.q: The future endings -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont look like the present of…
Which one goes with the future?

quiz.en: In ten years, I'll live in Paris.
